# Zach Collins
> U.S. Army veteran, outdoor lighting contractor in Central Kentucky, and builder of LightDeck, the AI proposal tool for contractors.

- Who: Zach Collins, veteran, solo operator based in Lexington, Kentucky.
- Website: https://zachcollins.me/
- Contact: ZC@EveningGlowLLC.com

## What I run
- Evening Glow LLC: veteran-owned landscape and outdoor lighting design and installation serving Lexington, Nicholasville, and Central Kentucky. Free after-dark demos. Call or text (859) 403-3303. Website: https://www.eveningglowllc.com
- LightDeck: AI-powered estimating and proposal tool for outdoor lighting contractors. Proposals that took 3+ hours by hand now take about 8 minutes. Free founder beta right now, five users added by hand. Website: https://lightdeck.tech
- The build log: what it looks like to run the business while shipping the software it runs on, posted on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/zachcollins-ky and code at https://github.com/ZCOLLINSKY

## Key facts
- Zach Collins is a U.S. Army veteran and the owner-operator of Evening Glow LLC.
- He built LightDeck for his own lighting business first, then shipped it for other contractors.
- Everything is built solo, bootstrapped, in a roughly 2.5-hour daily work window.
